heading: One role, spanning both organizations
intro: DV asked for a builder with zero friction from the broader organization, and a change agent who transforms the existing team. Sriram asked to build an AI-first product inside his remit. A single role serves both asks at once, structured as two connected responsibilities.

responsibilities.label: Build
responsibilities.title: In Sriram's organization
responsibilities.reportingLine: Part of Sriram's direct staff, SVP & GM, AI
responsibilities.summary: HP brings thoughts to life; owns a lean team and every decision behind a real, new AI-first product shipped to customers. This is the builder-and-solver DV described.
points: Decisions and implementation happen together: zero organizational distance between product strategy and what gets built
Architecture is built and shipped by the same team from day one, carried through by that team end to end
Matches the operating model OneTrust needs for a $400M new-business bet: startup pace inside an enterprise

responsibilities.label: Bridge / Change Agent / Catalyst
responsibilities.title: Inside DV's organization
responsibilities.reportingLine: Part of DV's direct or extended staff, CPTO (dual or dotted)
responsibilities.summary: HP is the change agent DV asked for, with ownership of overall architecture and the engineering of the AI Context Layer.
points: Direct working relationship into the full breadth of the existing platform and its engineering teams
Transformation grounded in production shipped work from the AI Context Layer, with continued end-to-end engineering to ensure consistency and velocity
Answers DV's ask to build, change, and scale the organization. Demonstrated through shipped work in production.

closing.text: Two organizational lines, one accountable person, one execution model. A single-org version of this role gives up one of the three asks: DV's builder-and-solver, DV's change agent, or Sriram's integrated function. Over the next 12 to 18 months, once the product and its foundation are built out, the team finds its natural place as the business evolves.
